The top shelf seems to curve slightly upward or distort near the right edge, inconsistent with the rigid linear perspective of the lower shelves.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the wooden side of the bookcase and the wall/hanging items is soft and indistinct, suggesting a blending or fusion error rather than a sharp occlusion boundary.
